description: I am Niranjan of grade 7, a young innovator passionate about space, robotics, and technology. Driven by curiosity and creativity, I aim to turn imaginative ideas into innovative solutions. I enjoy solving problems and exploring how science and engineering can shape the future. My goal is to think beyond limits, create meaningful innovations, and take one step closer to the stars. I believe one mind, one vision, and determination can make a big difference.
summary:
Mission Explorer is an interactive space survival game where players build and manage their own Moon base. Players can drive a rover, collect resources, build habitats, and manage oxygen, water, food, and electricity to keep astronauts alive.

The project addresses the challenge by helping kids understand what it takes to survive on the Moon through fun, hands-on gameplay. Players make decisions, solve problems, and learn that every resource is important and every choice has consequences.

This project is important because it makes space science easier and more exciting to learn. It helps children develop problem-solving skills and inspires them to become future scientists, engineers, and astronauts.
details: Mission Explorer is an interactive space survival game where players explore the Moon, collect resources, build a base, and keep astronauts alive by managing oxygen, water, food, and electricity. We created it using Base44, an AI-powered website-building platform. Our goal is to make learning about space fun and easy for children aged 7–12. Through gameplay, children learn about space exploration, resource management, and problem-solving. The game is creative because it allows players to experience what it is like to manage their own Moon base instead of just reading about it. We focused on making it fun, educational, simple to use, and accessible through a web browser. Mission Explorer aims to inspire children to explore STEM and become future scientists, engineers, and astronauts.
